bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to child care; establishing a system for uploading child care provider slot availability to Parent Aware; appropriating money; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 142D.13, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 142D.13, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 5.

Slot availability data integration.

(a) By July 1, 2027, the commissioner shall create a method for automatically uploading child care slot availability data from the majority of child care providers' management software and display the up-to-date slot availability information on Parent Aware. The commissioner may use shared services grant money to assist providers in obtaining and training in software that can upload to Parent Aware under section 142D.22, subdivision 3, clause (7).

(b) The commissioner must ensure that the process under this subdivision only uploads data on slot availability and does not include any potentially confidential information.

Sec. 2. APPROPRIATION; CHILD CARE DATA INTEGRATION.

(a) $....... in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated to the commissioner of children, youth, and families to establish a method for automatically uploading child care slot availability data from child care provider management software pursuant to Minnesota Statutes, section 142D.13, subdivision 5. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until July 1, 2028.

(b) The general fund base for maintaining the child care availability upload system in Minnesota Statutes, section 142D.13, subdivision 5, is $....... in fiscal year 2028 and $....... in fiscal year 2029.
